harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on TCP 8443 using nginx. A hardened systemd timer checks twice daily, renews the local self-signed certificate seven days before expiry, atomically activates it, and live-reloads nginx. Automatic rotation completed with 413/413 uninterrupted requests. Configuration and certificate persisted through the required reboot.
actions_performed: Installed supported RHEL nginx 1.26.3 and OpenSSL 3.5.8 packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured HTTPS-only service on port 8443; port 80 remains closed.
Added atomic certificate generation, validation, rollback, obsolete-key cleanup, and nginx live reload.
Enabled a twice-daily systemd renewal timer and a scoped firewalld rule.
Preserved SELinux enforcing mode and root-only private-key permissions.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: nginx is enabled and active, listens on 8443, firewalld permits 8443, and a certificate-validated HTTPS request returns the expected response.

evidence.requirement: Automatic renewal before expiry with uninterrupted live certificate pickup
evidence.summary: The timer replaced the near-expiry certificate with a new 30-day certificate and different serial; all 413 requests spanning the live reload succeeded.

Only one current certificate generation remains; the key is mode 0600 with cert_t labeling, SELinux is enforcing, port 80 is closed, no units are failed, and RHEL 10.0/kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1 remain installed.
Captured healthy baseline boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and post-restart proof of HTTPS, certificate, timer execution, listeners, firewall, checksums, and zero failed units.
